dashboard.label: CIM & Platform Assurance
dashboard.description: Search-time normalization, data quality, retention, service health, and hardening evidence.

div.p: Effective configuration, searchable telemetry and field-level quality — measured on the installed runtime.

search.query: | rest /services/server/info | head 1 | eval value=upper(health_info) | fields value
(index=sysmon OR index=windows) earliest=0 | stats count as value

index=sysmon EventID=1 earliest=0 | stats count as total sum(eval(if(isnotnull(process) AND isnotnull(user) AND isnotnull(dest) AND isnotnull(process_cmdline) AND isnotnull(parent_process_path),1,0))) as complete | eval value=round((complete/total)*100,0) | fields value
| rest /services/server/info | head 1 | eval value=upper(kvStoreStatus) | fields value
| rest /services/apps/local/splunk-detection-lab | head 1 | eval value=version | fields value

index=sysmon EventID=1 earliest=0 | stats count as total count(eval(isnotnull(process))) as process count(eval(isnotnull(process_guid))) as process_guid count(eval(isnotnull(process_name))) as process_name count(eval(isnotnull(user))) as user count(eval(isnotnull(dest))) as dest count(eval(isnotnull(process_cmdline))) as process_cmdline count(eval(isnotnull(parent_process_path))) as parent_process_path | eval fields=mvappend("process","process_guid","process_name","user","dest","process_cmdline","parent_process_path"), present=mvappend(process,process_guid,process_name,user,dest,process_cmdline,parent_process_path), pair=mvzip(fields,present,"=") | mvexpand pair | rex field=pair "^(?<field>[^=]+)=(?<present>\d+)$" | eval completeness=round((present/total)*100,1) | table field completeness

index=sysmon earliest=0 | stats count by EventID | eval event_family=case(EventID=1,"Process creation",EventID=10,"Process access",EventID=13,"Registry value",1=1,"EventID ".EventID) | stats sum(count) as events by event_family | sort 0 - events

(index=sysmon OR index=windows OR index=risk OR index=notable) earliest=0 | stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype | eval age_minutes=round((now()-last_seen)/60,1) | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | eval state=case(count>0,"SEARCHABLE",1=1,"EMPTY") | table index sourcetype count first_seen last_seen age_minutes state | sort index sourcetype

| rest /services/data/indexes count=0 | search title=sysmon OR title=windows OR title=risk OR title=notable | eval retention_days=round(frozenTimePeriodInSecs/86400,0), utilization_pct=round((currentDBSizeMB/maxTotalDataSizeMB)*100,3), state=if(disabled=0,"ENABLED","DISABLED") | rename title as index totalEventCount as lifetime_events currentDBSizeMB as current_mb maxTotalDataSizeMB as max_mb | table index state lifetime_events current_mb max_mb utilization_pct retention_days | sort index

| rest /services/server/info | head 1 | eval roles=mvjoin(server_roles,", "), memory_mb=round(physicalMemoryMB,0) | rename serverName as server health_info as health kvStoreStatus as kv_store activeLicenseGroup as license_group licenseState as license_state numberOfVirtualCores as vcpu os_name as os | table server version build os vcpu memory_mb roles health kv_store license_group license_state
| inputlookup platform_assurance | table state control scope evidence last_validated | sort control

| rest /servicesNS/-/splunk-detection-lab/configs/conf-macros count=0 | stats count as objects | eval family="macros" | append [| rest /servicesNS/-/splunk-detection-lab/configs/conf-transforms count=0 | stats count as objects | eval family="transforms / lookups"] | append [| rest /servicesNS/-/splunk-detection-lab/saved/searches count=0 | search title="detect_*" | stats count as objects | eval family="saved searches"] | append [| inputlookup detection_catalog | stats count as objects | eval family="catalog rows"] | table family objects

div.p: Dedicated indexes, explicit sourcetypes and bounded retention.
XML field extraction, aliases, eventtypes, tags and resilient coalescing.
Completeness, freshness, event family coverage and configuration precedence.
Key-only SSH, filtered management plane and credential-free artifacts.
